Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to accurately identify the headquarters of Universal Music Group (UMG) during the initial searches. The agent mistakenly concluded that the corporate headquarters of UMG is in Hilversum, Netherlands, when the operational headquarters is located in Santa Monica, California. This misidentification led to the entire chain of reasoning focusing on Hilversum rather than Santa Monica, which would have been the correct city to investigate for the problem. This incorrect focus on Hilversum ultimately caused the solution to deviate from the real-world problem's requirements.
